0.long_answer: Keratosis follicularis‐dwarfism‐cerebral atrophy syndrome is an exceedingly rare genetic disorder characterized by generalized keratosis follicularis, marked dwarfism, and cerebral atrophy. In the limited number of cases reported in the medical literature, all six known patients with this syndrome have been identified in Turkey. This observation, supported by detailed clinical and genetic analyses, underlines the significance of regional case studies in shedding light on rare genodermatoses. Although worldwide occurrence is extremely low, the Turkish cohort remains the only source of such documented cases.
